text.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas
text.body_text: Donald Trump has said he will ban US companies from building AI data centres overseas, threatening a "tremendous tax" for tech firms who do so. "We're going to keep it all in this country," the US president said, while providing little detail on the potential policy he said others in his cabinet were hearing about for the first time.
text.summary: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.
text.alt_text: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas — BBC News - World

text.title: IPCC report delay will threaten global effort to tackle climate crisis, says top scientist
text.body_text: Climate science is “foundational” to the Paris agreement and worldwide progress on tackling global heating, and attempts to delay new scientific reports threaten global cooperation on tackling the crisis, one of the world’s leading climate scientists has warned.
text.summary: Johan Rockström, one of world’s leading climate experts, says slowing down scientific work puts cooperation at risk Climate science is “foundational” to the Paris agreement and worldwide progress on tackling global heating, and attempts to delay new scientific reports threaten global cooperation on tackling the crisis, one of the world’s leading climate scientists has warned. Johan Rockström, the director of the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research, said the world’s leading body of climate scientists, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, must be allowed to work as quickly as possible on its next comprehensive assessment of global knowledge of the climate systems .
text.alt_text: IPCC report delay will threaten global effort to tackle climate crisis, says top scientist — The Guardian - Science
